title: PATCH /api/users/me/password — change password with current password verification
description: Allow users to change their password by verifying the current password first. Not available for OAuth-only accounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 400 if user has no password (OAuth-only account)
Returns 200 on success, invalidates all refresh tokens (force re-login)

steps.details: Validate { currentPassword: string, newPassword: string.min(8) }. Fetch user. If user.passwordHash is null, return 400 'Password login not available for OAuth accounts'. bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.passwordHash) — if false, 401. Hash newPassword. Update user. Delete all refresh_tokens for user. Return 200.
Change password with correct current — verify new password works. Try with wrong current — expect 401. Try on OAuth user — expect 400.
